description:
FILED s526w2 (Opus, resumed s528 2026-10-25), from the Log-Log4perl-1.58 board census (the debug lines appear in every Log4perl test's output; t/020Easy.t row 19 reads them as its got).  PRE-EXISTING (main 31cd8c02).  NOT REDUCED to a small program.

    ./pl2cl --module < ~/.cpan/build/Log-Log4perl-1.58-0/lib/Log/Log4perl/Appender.pm
  emits, for line 63 `print "Appender class $appenderclass loaded OK ($@)\n" if _INTERNAL_DEBUG;`:
        (p-if "_INTERNAL_DEBUG" (p-print ...))
  where every later sub (lines 120-270) gets (p-if (p-scalar-ctx (|Log::Log4perl::Appender|::pl-_INTERNAL_DEBUG)) ...).  The unit's detect table agrees: lines 29 and 63 "unknown", lines 120..270 "proto:".
  perl: the constant is 0, nothing printed.  Probe scratch/s526w2/pconst.pl: perl "made"; PCL prints the three debug lines first.
BISECT (scratch/s526w2/pa1.pm, pa2.pm): deleting lines 97-106 (`if (!$INC{'Log/Log4perl/Config.pm'}) { require Log::Log4perl::Config; }` + the compile_if_perl `if`) fixes it; so does deleting lines 113-307 (every sub AFTER new).  The first 70 lines alone are right (pm3.pm).  A minimal module (`use constant _DBG => 0; sub f { print "a" if _DBG }`) is right.  So the parse of `sub new` happens -- or is redone -- with an environment that does not hold this package's constant, triggered by the `require` of a sibling module that declares the SAME constant name in ANOTHER package (Log::Log4perl::Config line 16) together with something in the later subs.  Suspect the prototype merge of a required module (a re-parse / scope of the constant record by bare name).
ROWS: t/020Easy.t 19 and the stdout noise in every Log4perl file; everyday-shaped (any Log4perl user).
subject: SILENT WRONG: inside Log::Log4perl::Appender's `sub new`, the `use constant _INTERNAL_DEBUG => 0` name is emitted as the bareword STRING "_INTERNAL_DEBUG" (true) -- every Log4perl program prints "Appender class ... loaded OK" / "Calling ... new" debug lines on STDOUT
